title: Week 09 · Pipelines, Domain, and Polish
excerpt: Custom domain live, automated weekly article publishing, and a week of fixes and tooling improvements.
content:
## What Shipped This Week

A productive week focused on infrastructure polish and automation.

### ingramgeoai.com
Moved the portfolio off GitHub's default subdirectory path onto a proper custom domain. DNS on Cloudflare, HTTPS via Cloudflare's Universal SSL. Clean URL, no subdirectory weirdness.

### Weekly Article Pipeline
Built an automated publishing pipeline for this site. A build log tracks what gets shipped each week. Every Sunday night, a script reads the log, formats it with local AI, pushes the result to the site, and resets for the next week. No manual publishing step.

### ParcelIQ Fixes
Filter panel overflow on mobile, draw UI polish, and confirmed production stability at parcel-iq.org.

### Pain Points
- GitHub Pages custom domain cert provisioning has no API trigger — it's fully async and opaque. Just have to wait.
- Cloudflare's proxy and GitHub Pages HTTPS don't play well together out of the box — workaround: keep proxy on, set SSL mode to Flexible.

title: Week 08 · Shipping ParcelIQ: From Zero to Production
excerpt: Built a full GIS parcel map app in ~90 minutes of active coding — 46k parcels, AI search, draw & query, color ramps, mobile-first UI. Here's what worked and what broke.
content:
## ParcelIQ: Built in ~90 Minutes

ParcelIQ is a Laramie County Wyoming parcel map — 46,000 parcels, full attribute search, AI-powered natural language queries, and a mobile-first UI. Core app went from zero to production in about 90 minutes.

### The Stack
- **Cloudflare Pages** — frontend hosting
- **Cloudflare Worker** — API layer with rate limiting and CORS
- **Cloudflare D1** — SQLite at the edge, stores all 46k parcel records
- **Cloudflare R2** — vector tile storage
- **MapLibre GL JS** — map rendering
- **Workers AI** — natural language parcel search

### Features Shipped
- Symbology switcher: Actual Value / Assessed / $/Acre / Acreage
- 6 color ramp presets with dark/light mode variants
- Draw & Query: polygon draw → spatial query → stats panel
- CSV export
- Value and acreage filter sliders
- Owner portfolio view
- Shareable URLs with parcel pre-selection

### Pain Points
- Multi-origin CORS on Cloudflare Workers requires explicit `Vary: Origin` headers
- D1 batch inserts cap at 100 rows — need chunking for large datasets
- Aerial imagery proxy still broken (URL encoding edge case in ArcGIS exportImage)

### Live
**https://parcel-iq.org** — free and public.
